title: A Blister on the Class Walk
story: The class walk was longer than Yusuf expected. By the second hill his heel began to sting. He sat on a wall and pulled off his boot. A pale blister had formed. Teacher Cole opened the first-aid kit and gave him a soft plaster. She told him not to pop the blister. Yusuf pressed the plaster on and laced the boot more loosely. He walked at the back with a friend who carried his water. At the finish he was sore but proud. That evening he soaked the foot and let the blister dry. He chose thicker socks for the next walk.
